prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: one high-fidelity desktop website first-viewport design comp, 1536 by 1024 pixels, flat screenshot with no browser frame.
Primary request: Design Birdcar's new marketing homepage in the Applied Future direction: classic technology identity with a personal signature. Advanced Silicon Valley technical capability made practical for established business owners. Clean, classic, type-and-animation-led, precise and quietly glamorous. The page must clearly explain the service and invite a free assessment. This is a website with navigation, text hierarchy, an obvious functional CTA, and an actual work section entering below the fold; never a poster.

Page structure:
1. Top navigation 94px high on near-white #f8faff. Left at 88px, Birdcar wordmark in real Alkaline script lettering, cobalt blue, about 44px high. On right, understated Public Sans navigation, actual text: "How I work", "Selected work", "Writing", then "Book a free assessment" with a small thin right-arrow icon. Generous clear space; nav links about 16px.
2. Broad cobalt #2041df hero from y94 through approximately y742, filling about 63 percent of the entire frame. Left content aligned at x88, no side rails. Dominant left-aligned white Alkaline statement, two lines: "Make room" / "for better work." The lettering is the licensed Alkaline script family: connected slanted brush-script strokes, sturdy yet elegant, distinctive looped lowercase f, bold clean curves, no swashes or added decoration. The visible existing reference screenshot shows ONLY the letter shapes; its mustard palette, illustration, composition, old section rails and dense layout are explicitly discarded. Use Alkaline for logo and hero, Public Sans for all readable supporting text. Main statement occupies roughly y155 to y398 with generous right-hand negative space.
Directly below statement, readable white Public Sans introduction at around 27px, max width 950px, text verbatim: "I help businesses untangle work that’s become harder to keep up with."
Then a shorter paragraph at 18px, two lines maximum, text verbatim: "The reporting someone spends Friday assembling. The follow-up that depends on your memory. The process that keeps landing back on your desk."
Place a solid near-white rectangular button at y610 with comfortable padding, slight 3px rounding, cobalt text "Book a free assessment" and an understated thin arrow. Immediately alongside the button, quiet icy-blue #b9d9ff text says exactly "About an hour. Free assessment. A report to keep." Keep text crisp and at least 16px; Commit Mono may be used only for this useful assessment duration/detail, otherwise no decorative monospaced labels. The entire offer is visibly grouped with the action.
Add ONE restrained optical light edge near the bottom of the cobalt field, suggesting a precise light sweep that would animate and settle in the finished website. It is a hairline of icy light, elegant and faintly luminous, never a fuzzy halo, illustration, orb, mesh, or science-fiction scene. No other decoration. The cobalt remains decisively flat and rich.
3. At y742 the page continues into a clean #f8faff work section. Around x88 y805, heading "Work in practice." in midnight #171f38 Public Sans, around 36px, followed by "A useful system has a place in the business. Here’s one I’ve built." at 19px. On right around x760 y805, actual case-study title "Craft & Communicate" in cobalt Public Sans around 29px. Beneath it, readable dark text verbatim: "I built a client-facing reporting platform that brings together performance data and gives the agency something it can offer its customers." At the bottom, an ordinary blue text link "Read about the work" with a thin arrow. No case-study thumbnail is needed. Make this lower section substantial enough to prove the page's typography and content system.

Palette: cobalt #2041df dominant field, near-white #f8faff, midnight #171f38 for readable text on white, icy-blue #b9d9ff restrained details. Not the old mustard, brick, cream, teal palette. Use a consistent 88px left and right page margin, optical precision, generous whitespace, excellent contrast, extraordinarily clean typography and meticulous alignment. Real website proportions.
Constraints: reproduce exact text, with nothing invented. No claims about revenue, savings, results, endorsements, availability or clients beyond the actual Craft & Communicate prose. No illustration, people, portraits, fake dashboard, fake metrics, geometric wallpaper, badges, arbitrary eyebrows, section numbers, client logos, cards, extra decorative controls, extra slogans, gradients in text, or browser/device frame. No floating hero object. This image communicates sophisticated technical capability through color, clear typography, restrained optical light and the practical service copy.
